hero.heading: An energy gel made from honey. Three or four ingredients.
hero.subtitle: Energy gels, isotonic drinks and whey protein made by APIMAR in Poland. The gels are made from multifloral honey and freeze-dried fruit, with no sucralose and no artificial colours.
hero.trustHoney: Multifloral honey as the main ingredient

whyHbp.title: Three or four ingredients, nothing else
whyHbp.subtitle: Made by APIMAR in Poland; Planet Bio is the distributor for Croatia. The ingredients are printed on the back of every pack.
whyHbp.reason1Desc: Honey from Polish apiaries makes up 91–95.5% of the gel, depending on the flavour.
whyHbp.reason2Desc: Freeze-dried lemon, orange or raspberry gives the flavour and colour. No artificial colours.
whyHbp.reason3Desc: Guarana seed extract (1%) contains caffeine. Not recommended for people sensitive to caffeine, pregnant or breastfeeding women, or children.
whyHbp.reason4Desc: The lemon and orange gels contain 0.5% sea salt. The raspberry gel has no salt.
